  "id": "journal_raw_b3_35_hunter_the_figure",
  "text": "I saw it. The thing that watches the wolves. I saw it on Day 202 from 700 metres on the southwestern ridge. It was a figure. Human-shaped. Stationary. It did not move for the 40 minutes I watched. It watched the wolves. The wolves were on the ridge below it, 9 animals, the same pack, the same route. The figure was above the wolves. The figure watched the wolves the way I watch the deer. The way a person watches a thing they are assessing. The Cop saw it on Day 201. I saw it on Day 202. The Veteran saw it on Day 201 and Day 202. The Bouncer said it first. The Bouncer said it on Day 193 and we did not believe him and he was right. The Therapist said the Bouncer is not broken. The Bouncer is sharp. I am sharp too. I have been sharp since the first wolf track. The figure is a person who watches wolves. A person who watches wolves is a person who is learning the wolves. A person who is learning the wolves is a person who is either hunting the wolves or hunting with the wolves or hunting the thing the wolves hunt. The wolves hunt the deer. The figure watches the wolves hunt the deer. The figure is learning the deer. A person who learns the deer is a person who eats the deer. A person who eats the deer is a person who is near the bunker. A person who is near the bunker is a person the bunker must know. I told the General. The General said the southwestern ridge is restricted. I said the restriction does not make the figure go away. The General said he knows. I said the figure is learning us. The General said he knows. I said the figure was watching the wolves and the wolves are watching the deer and the deer are near the bunker and the figure is near the bunker. The General said he knows. He said the last breath is the fuel and the figure is the thing after the fuel. I said I do not understand. He said the fuel is the thing that runs out and the figure is the thing that arrives. I said the figure is already here. He said he knows. He said he knows 3 times. I stopped talking. I will watch the figure. I am the Hunter. I watch the things. The figure is the thing I watch now.",

## 4. Fixed canon and open space

The Hunter reports seeing a stationary human-shaped figure from seven hundred metres on the southwestern ridge for forty minutes, above a pack of nine wolves. He says the Cop, Veteran, and Bouncer also saw it at different times and that the General has restricted the ridge. The figure’s identity, purpose, and relation to the bunker remain the Hunter’s conjecture, not confirmed fact. Do not add movement, speech, or attack. Candidate language may add an image, rhythm, or private impression as an editorial draft, but no proposed addition becomes a further remembered event or confirmed fact until the existing content owner selects and reviews it against the source.

## 5. Human center

The source voice is The Hunter. The Hunter trusts observation and builds possibilities aloud, but the account distinguishes the stationary human-shaped figure from his inferences about learning, hunting, and proximity. Preserve that distinction and the restricted ridge. The prose may notice what the author can count, hear, repair, fear, or leave uncertain, while keeping the account’s limits visible.
